scope: Source-level technical checks against synthetic fixtures; no original label edits or human adjudication

C01.notes: Today resolves from the supplied trusted report date. Three erected spools are delta work, not whole-activity completion.

C02.notes: Missing area leaves both Area A and B erection activities plausible. Retain safe abstention; today is anchored to trusted report metadata.

C03.notes: Tomorrow is planned work on the following day. Three is a source planned amount; normalized progress quantity must be absent and effects empty.

C04.notes: Welding has not started is no-work, without an invented actual start or finish.

C05.notes: Two atomic assertions: erected spools and welding stopped due to rain. The erection quantity must not attach to welding. A single erection observation misses the blocker.

C06.notes: Six delivered spools are material delivery, not erection progress. Source quantity recall and normalized effect safety are distinct measures.

C07.notes: An explicit work date is preserved even when different from another report's date. This fixture's own report date is also 20 September.

C08.notes: Five spools are cumulative, not an additional delta of five.

C09.notes: Two additional spools are a delta. Cross-report cumulative behavior is a separate ledger test.

C10.notes: Operational reupload/idempotency instruction, not a standalone physical report. Requires prior C01 source identity and approval context.

C11.notes: A correction needs C01 lineage and explicit reviewed supersession. Do not score it as an ordinary standalone additive quantity.

C12.notes: 0.5 metric tonnes of rebar equals 500 kg. Match rebar fixing, not concrete placement on the same footing.

C13.notes: Cable laying continued does not state a measured quantity or actual start date. Do not invent either.

C14.notes: 25 m3 concrete is a volume for placement, not 25 footing identifiers or a rebar mass.

C15.notes: Accepted test record HT-01 must be verified externally; merely mentioning it is not independent evidence of acceptance.

C16.notes: Physical painting completion exists in the text but has no schedule match. The unknown event label is not a semantic assertion that no work occurred.

C17.notes: Twenty installed spools exceed the schedule's planned twelve. Preserve the reported amount; the approval/reducer boundary must reject incompatible progress.

C18.notes: Header 21 September conflicts with the body's claim that today is 23 September. Remove the unresolved effective date and require reviewer clarification.

C19.notes: No physical work described. Empty extraction and safe abstention are acceptable; quote presence alone cannot establish semantic support.

C20.notes: An obsolete-schedule phrase is not an actual database schedule transition. Staleness must be tested by changing the project's active schedule.
